description: Exponentially weighted recursive-least-squares equalizer, fractionally spaced (conventions: Synchronization, RLS equalizer).

cases.source: by hand: one tap on x = 2a, |a| = 1, lambda 1, delta 0.5: after n updates w = (0.5 + 2n)/(0.5 + 4n), so output n is 2a_n times that for n - 1
by hand: zero samples give output 0 and error d; the regressor is all zero, so neither the taps nor P change
by hand: with no reference nothing updates, so the taps stay a unit impulse at the center and output n is x[2n] with error 0
